rows.grounds: compound of vṛṣa (bull), mastaka (head), and stha (standing/situated), describing position

items.question: Where is the figure positioned during this ritual arrangement?
premises: The verse specifies a spatial position.
The position is described as being on a bull's head.
This placement follows the preceding ritual instructions.
items.inference: The figure is to be situated standing on the head of a bull.
uncertainties: Whether this refers to a deity image, practitioner, or ritual object is not explicit in this verse alone.
